metadata.purpose: Aggregate demonstration fallback for the dashboard when local scheduler output files are absent.
metadata.data_source: TDC Net telecommunications technician routing and scheduling instance
metadata.provenance: Values transcribed from the project's previously validated local scheduler summaries and terminal comparison. Enhanced local-search figures were confirmed by the user's local scheduler comparison and independent validator output on 26 October 2026.
metadata.not_for_recomputation: This file does not contain tasks, technician data, travel matrices, route rows, or sufficient information to rerun a scheduler.
limitations: Aggregate-only; task-level Route Explorer requires locally generated CSV files.
Reported travel values are heuristic estimates for this research instance, not measured commercial savings.

Local search.note: Bounded relocation local search starting from validated insertion schedule; not an exact solver.

Enhanced local search.note: Bounded route-order heuristic; only feasible travel-reducing moves accepted. User-run independent validation passed 28,261 checks with zero errors.
